name: Israel, Gaza & region
summary: US strikes near Hormuz on 2 Nov; Israeli strikes in Lebanon; Houthi–Saudi attacks
state: The US struck Iranian targets on Qeshm Island near Hormuz on 2 Nov while Qatar-led talks continue (CBS). Israeli strikes hit southern Lebanon on 2 Nov; Lebanon's health ministry says 4,389 people were killed from 2 Mar to 30 Oct (Arab News). The Houthis claimed drone attacks on Saudi airports on 2 Nov. Iran's terms include an end to fighting on all fronts.
for_you: Follow FCDO travel advice for Israel, Lebanon, Iran, Yemen and the Gulf states.
